title.zh: 条形图 · 让数字站成一排比高矮
title.en: Bar Charts · Numbers Standing in a Row

description.zh: 柱高表示数值，可读差、可见纵轴起点如何改变视觉差距，并用平均线补平高出与不足。仅用 8 个示意数据。
description.en: Bar height encodes value; read differences, see how the axis start changes apparent gaps, and balance excess against shortfall with a mean line. Uses 8 illustrative values only.

label.en: The mean is a balance point

reason.zh: 平均线使高出的总长等于不足的总长，这正是期望作为概率加权重心的最简单情形（各结果权重相同）。
reason.en: The mean line makes total excess equal total shortfall, the simplest case (equal weights) of expectation as a probability-weighted balance point.

title.zh: 平均数在图上到底是什么？
title.en: What is the mean on a chart?

ask.zh: 柱子有高有低，平均线画在哪里，才会让高出部分刚好补平不足部分？
ask.en: With bars of different heights, where must the mean line sit so the excess exactly fills the shortfall?

ask.zh: 如果再来一个新数据，它落在平均线上面，会把平均数往上拉还是往下拉？
ask.en: If one new value lands above the mean line, does it pull the mean up or down?

reveal.zh: 平均线就是让高出与不足互相抵消的那条线；新数据高于平均线会把平均数往上拉，低于则往下拉。
reveal.en: The mean line is the level where excess and shortfall cancel out; a new value above it pulls the mean up, below it pulls it down.
